title: Guía de inicio en español para rcol
text: El paquete organiza sus 46 funciones públicas en dos familias: col_*(): Funciones de alto nivel diseñadas para trabajar directamente con la versión extendida más reciente del Catalogue Life ("3LXR"). La versión se fija automáticamente en la sesión (col_key()). clb_*(): Funciones universales de bajo nivel que aceptan el argumento dataset = para consultar cualquier conjunto de datos publicado en ChecklistBank.
code: col_key()      # Clave numérica fijada para la sesión col_refresh()  # Fuerza la actualización a una versión más reciente

title: Guía de inicio en español para rcol
text: Para verificar nombres científicos y obtener un resumen depurado de 9 columnas con el nombre aceptado válido y su estado taxonómico:
code: # Verificación depurada de 1 o más especies (9 columnas) col_check_name(c("Werneria nubigena", "Panthera leo", "Schinus molle"))  # Coincidencia directa completa (16 columnas) col_match("Panthera leo")  # Inspeccionar candidatos homónimos col_match_verbose("Oenanthe")  # Búsqueda masiva en paralelo col_match_checklist(c("Panthera leo", "Bufo bufo", "Abies alba"))

title: Guía de inicio en español para rcol
text: Todas las funciones de relación aceptan indistintamente nombres científicos directos, vectores de especies, IDs alfanuméricos o tablas de resultados:
code: # Jerarquía taxonómica en formato Ancho o Largo col_classification("Schinus molle", wide = TRUE)  # Sinónimos taxonómicos para múltiples especies col_synonyms(c("Werneria nubigena", "Panthera leo"))  # Nombres comunes con trazabilidad de especies (columna scientific_name) col_vernacular(c("Werneria nubigena", "Panthera leo"))  # Distribución geográfica oficial en formato tidy col_distribution(c("Werneria nubigena", "Schinus molle"))

title: Guía de inicio en español para rcol
code: # Nodos raíz del árbol (Reinos / Dominios) raices <- col_tree()  # Hijos taxonómicos directos col_children("Panthera")  # Búsqueda por texto libre col_usage_search("Felidae", rank = "species")

title: Getting started with rcol
text: functions come two forms: col_*() target latest extended COL release without needing dataset argument. "3LXR" release alias resolved integer dataset key cached session via col_key(), long-running work disrupted new release published midway. Use col_refresh() deliberately re-pin newest release. clb_*() take dataset = argument work dataset ChecklistBank historical COL releases.
code: col_key()      # Pinned integer dataset key of the latest extended release col_refresh()  # Re-resolve to the newest release

title: Getting started with rcol
text: Almost every function takes dataset = argument identifying checklist work . can pass: numeric dataset key, e.g. 3 (COL project), dataset alias "COL25" (2025 annual release), one magic COL release aliases always resolve recent release ("3LR" monthly base, "3LXR" monthly extended).
code: clb_col_release("monthly")                  # "3LR"   latest monthly base release clb_col_release("monthly", extended = TRUE) # "3LXR"  latest monthly extended release clb_col_release("annual")                   # e.g. "COL25"  # List all available COL releases clb_col_releases()

title: Getting started with rcol
text: col_check_name() provides clean, 9-column resolution summary showing accepted name, authorship, status, ID single multiple species: match specific dataset rather latest COL release, use clb_match() dataset = key alias:
code: # Clean 9-column verification col_check_name(c("Werneria nubigena", "Panthera leo", "Schinus molle"))  # Full raw match (16 columns) col_match("Panthera leo")  # Inspect homonym candidates col_match_verbose("Oenanthe")  # Match many names in parallel col_match_checklist(c("Panthera leo", "Bufo bufo", "Abies alba")) clb_match("Felis catus", dataset = "COL25") clb_match("Bellis perennis", dataset = 2099)

title: Getting started with rcol
text: relationship functions accept direct scientific names, character vectors species, taxon IDs, match data frames:
code: # Hierarchical classification in Wide or Long format col_classification("Schinus molle", wide = TRUE)  # Synonyms for single or multiple species col_synonyms(c("Werneria nubigena", "Panthera leo"))  # Vernacular/common names with species traceability (scientific_name column) col_vernacular(c("Werneria nubigena", "Panthera leo"))  # Geographic distribution in tidy format col_distribution(c("Werneria nubigena", "Schinus molle"))

what: R Client for the Catalogue of Life / ChecklistBank API
title: R Client for the Catalogue of Life / ChecklistBank API
text: rcol R client Catalogue Life via ChecklistBank API (https://api.checklistbank.org). lets match scientific names, look datasets, taxa name usages, navigate taxonomic tree, extract classifications, retrieve synonyms, vernacular names, geographic distribution records, run ChecklistBank parsers — public dataset ChecklistBank latest Catalogue Life release. modelled conventions rgbif taxadb. two parallel families functions: clb_*() work dataset take dataset = argument. col_*() convenience siblings always target latest extended Catalogue Life release drop dataset argument. first use release alias "3LXR" resolved concrete integer key pinned rest session (via col_key()), release published mid-session never changes data long-running job. Call col_refresh() pick new release purpose.

title: R Client for the Catalogue of Life / ChecklistBank API
text: Flexible Inputs: downstream functions (col_synonyms(), col_vernacular(), col_distribution(), col_classification(), col_usage(), col_children()) accept direct scientific names (e.g. "Werneria nubigena"), taxon IDs (e.g. "4CGXP"), match data frames interchangeably. Vectorized Multi-Name Support: Pass single names character vectors multiple species (e.g. c("Werneria nubigena", "Panthera leo")) receive clean, concatenated tidy data frames species traceability. Clean Name Verification: col_check_name() / clb_check_name() provide clean 9-column resolution summary showing accepted names, status, IDs without raw JSON overhead. HTML-Free Full Names: Full name fields tree navigation columns (full_name) stripped HTML formatting direct use reports publications.

title: R Client for the Catalogue of Life / ChecklistBank API
text: Install development version GitHub: Documentation published https://catalogueoflife.github.io/rcol/.
code: # install.packages("pak") pak::pak("CatalogueOfLife/rcol")  # or # install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("CatalogueOfLife/rcol")

title: R Client for the Catalogue of Life / ChecklistBank API
text: match specific dataset instead latest COL release, use clb_*() form dataset = key alias:
code: library(rcol)  # High-level clean verification (9 columns) for 1 or multiple species col_check_name(c("Werneria nubigena", "Panthera leo", "Schinus molle"))  # Raw matching against the latest Catalogue of Life release col_match("Panthera leo")  # Disambiguate with rank and nomenclatural code col_match("Abies alba", rank = "species", code = "botanical")  # See all candidate matches (homonyms), not just the best one col_match_verbose("Oenanthe")  # Match many names at once in parallel col_match_checklist(c("Panthera leo", "Bufo bufo", "Abies alba")) clb_match("Felis catus", dataset = "COL25")          # the 2025 annual release clb_match("Macrocystis pyrifera", dataset = 2099)    # any public dataset by key

what: rcol: R Client for the Catalogue of Life / ChecklistBank API — rcol-package
title: rcol: R Client for the Catalogue of Life / ChecklistBank API — rcol-package
text: Access Catalogue Life (COL) ChecklistBank (CLB) web API https://api.checklistbank.org. Match scientific names public dataset latest COL release, look datasets, taxa name usages, navigate taxonomic tree, run ChecklistBank name value parsers, discover latest annual monthly COL base extended releases. Modelled conventions 'rgbif' 'taxadb'.

title: rcol 0.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2021-02-05 Initial release. col_*() shortcut functions (col_match(), col_usage(), col_tree(), …) always target latest extended COL release without dataset argument. release resolved integer key pinned session via col_key(); col_refresh() re-pins newer release. Name matching dataset COL release: clb_match(), clb_match_verbose(), clb_match_checklist(). COL release discovery: clb_col_release(), clb_col_releases() covering monthly base (3LR), monthly extended (3LXR) annual (COL<YY>) releases. Parsers: clb_parsers(), clb_parse_name(), clb_parse(). Datasets: clb_dataset_search(), clb_dataset(), clb_dataset_metrics(). Name usages taxa: clb_usage(), clb_usage_search() / clb_search(), clb_suggest(), clb_classification(), clb_synonyms(), clb_vernacular(), clb_usage_metrics(). Tree navigation: clb_tree(), clb_children().
